## {.archive-slide background-image="slides/02.webp" background-size="contain" background-color="#14140f"}

```{=html}
<div class="archive-text">Baseline- versus Cohort-Referenced Targets
• Growth Targets presume a desired achievement outcome (e.g., pro ciency) and a time frame to reach it.
• The achievement outcome and the time frame are the same regardless of whether we use baseline or cohort-referenced
norms

• Reality 1: Speed Limit 55mph • Reality 2: Speed Limit 75mph
• Destination is 150 miles away • Destination is 150 miles away
• “Normal” time to arrive 2 hours 45 minutes • “Normal” time to arrive: 2 hours.

• We don’t know which reality we are in right now.
• If the goal is to reach our destination in 2 hours, (pre-pandemic) rates of travel show this is typical. (Pandemic) rates of
travel show this is extraordinary.

• The destination and time frame is still the same. The baseline SGP would be relative to Reality 2 and the cohort-
referenced SGP would be relative to Reality 1.

fi</div>
```
